text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A close-coverage TV program?
choice_data_list: Yeah, seems like they want to capture our day to day life
Yeah, seems like they want to capture our day to day life

text_block_list.text:
It seems that the plan for this segment was 
to go behind-the-scenes on a horsegirl and 
her trainer who have become the centre of 
attention of this generation, though —

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hm～ There's some interesting people out 
there huh… Well, sounds alright to me, if 
we do it?
choice_data_list: Then I'll give them the OK

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Gotcha.

Then, it became the filming day. The crew 
have all arrived on site at the academy 
but —
choice_data_list: (Stego's… Not here!!)

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Hi there～ Would it be better 
if we changed the date…?
choice_data_list: Oh! Today should be all fine!

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I half expected this to happen. 
Which is why ——
choice_data_list: We're heading to Stego's location now

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a relief…! You can leave it to 
Trainer to know exactly where Stay Gold 
is right now!
choice_data_list: No, I'm actually not sure myself

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Eh……?
choice_data_list: But it should be completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh……??

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
choice_data_list: Stegooo!!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
N-No way… She really was here… 
It took an entire hour to drive 
here from the academy…?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo, it's Trainer… Oh —

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah～ Filming was today huh. My bad, 
my bad, I forgot about this.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Even so, what a surprise. Did you perhaps 
let your trainer know beforehand where 
you were going to be?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not at all. We normally 
just vibe it out like this.
choice_data_list: I'm always searching for her

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: I-I see……

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
This is going to be a "close coverage" kind 
of episode right. Then, right now it's —

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Woah! Is this going to be some sort of 
secret off campus training session…!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Time for food.
choice_data_list: Soba OK? I saw a nice store on the way

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh, sounds good. Let's go, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
S-So it's these two who make up the 
racing combo of this generation……

text_block_list.name: TV Voiceover
text_block_list.text:
"After that, the two continued to sway from 
place to place with perfect coordination, 
enjoying their day"

text_block_list.name: TV Voiceover
text_block_list.text:
"You can only describe the two as the 
closest of friends, and we were able to 
witness just how strong the bond which 
holds up all their achievements actually is —"
choice_data_list: (We ended up just strolling around…)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, feels as though they collected a 
few good scenes for us, though… 
Well, this is typical for us right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It's not like there were any lies either.
choice_data_list: Well… That's true

text_block_list.text:
…It was unexpected at the time, but this 
episode became such a hot topic amongst 
fans, to the point where many wished to 
see a second episode —

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"—Uhm…… To the best of my knowledge, 
those two always seemed that way to 
myself. If it's one day or another, they'll 
enjoy it to the fullest and such —"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"They're really great friends, aren't they! 
Because I see the two of them going 
'Wahaha' and smiling together a lot!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, we know them ve～ry well! Also about that fated bond of theirs which is absolutely unbreakable!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It is because they are 'travelling buddies' 
of course～ It matters not how far apart 
they are, because they will both always 
be facing the same direction～"

text_block_list.name: TV Voiceover
text_block_list.text:
"Just like that, it appears that those who 
know of their incredible mutual trust 
within the academy amount to many"

text_block_list.name: TV Voiceover
text_block_list.text:
"You can only describe the two as the 
closest of friends, and we were able to 
witness just how strong the bond which 
holds up all their achievements actually is —"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahah, I can't believe they even managed to interview Suzuka and the others.
choice_data_list: Everyone is saying the same thing…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's all the truth. No problems 
with that right?

text_block_list.text:
Just like that, the episode 
aired without any issues —

text_block_list.name: Stego Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gee～ Stego and Trainer, they just get 
each other, their friendship is really 
something huh. So this is what they 
call a best partner…

text_block_list.name: Stego Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold's trainer really is someone a bit 
peculiar hey. That is precisely what's so 
great about them though.
Sometime after the broadcast —

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm～ It's really become a hot topic huh.
choice_data_list: To think the fans would want a sequel…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahah. Everyone really enjoyed that one hey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let me see, should we go and film some 
unexplored region for the next one? 
And of course, we're only meeting up 
at the filming destination.
choice_data_list: Put yourself in my shoes～!
Put yourself in my shoes～!

text_block_list.text:
—That being said, it's not a bad feeling 
for the people around you to view you 
in a positive light.

This event confirmed that we both 
held the same belief in each other.
